elements.name: Supporting context
elements.content: Q2 2025 net sales were $44.320 million, down 55.2% year over year. Cash and available-for-sale investments totaled $189.883 million at June 27, 2025.

elements.name: Decisive point
elements.content: $28 was approximately 59% above STAAR's 90-day VWAP and 51% above its August 4, 2025 close.

elements.content: China sales: $5.299M versus $63.519M. Final case: approximately 10% annual sales growth from 2027. $58/share in April 2024 preceded the $28 agreement.
